10:62.text: the allies of Allāh there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve -

10:63.text: Those who believed and were fearing Allāh.

10:64.text: For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words
of Allāh. That is what is the great attainment.

10:65.text: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor
belongs to Allāh entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

10:66.text: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allāh do not
"partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but misjudging.

10:67.text: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight.
Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority
. Do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?

10:69.text: Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allāh will not succeed."

10:70.text: enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve.
